idle: Creek's still a little loud from last night.
If you get mud on the tablet, wipe it on the grass, not the porch.
wren.missionNudge: The water still has a story. Slope, creek, pond, reach.
wren.afterComplete: You traced the storm. The hollow's bigger than one rain, though.

items.name: Glacial erratic
items.prompt: A boulder sits on smaller rock. They don't match.
items.text: This boulder is very different from the bedrock beneath it. How did it get here?
items.wrenHint: If you're heading toward Granite Knob, take a look at the boulders near the north trail. Something about them doesn't quite fit.
items.wrenAck: That odd boulder on the north trail? I still don't have a tidy story for it.

items.name: Exposed bedrock
items.text: Layer after layer, the same rock as the knob. It looks older than the soil around it.
items.wrenHint: The east face of the knob is stripped. You can see the mountain, not just the trees.
items.wrenAck: You found the bare rock on the knob. That's the hollow's bones.

items.name: Fox Run
items.prompt: A thin thread of water joining the creek.
items.text: This little run wasn't on my mental map of a quiet day. Last night it had a voice.
items.wrenHint: West of the main creek there's a skinny drainage. Easy to miss unless you're looking at the ground.
items.wrenAck: Fox Run always looks like nothing until it rains.

items.name: Cut bank
items.prompt: The bank is undercut. Roots hang in empty air.
items.text: The creek is taking this side. The other side is keeping what the water drops.
items.wrenHint: Watch the outside of the bend below the woods. The bank isn't as solid as it looks.
items.wrenAck: That hanging-root bank? The creek's been chewing it for years. Last night just hurried.

items.name: Sand bar
items.prompt: Pale sand piled where the current slackens.
items.text: Fine stuff collected on the inside of the bend. The water slowed down here.
items.wrenHint: If the outside of a bend is stealing dirt, the inside is usually keeping some.
items.wrenAck: You found the bar. Same creek, two different jobs.

items.name: Rounded stones
items.prompt: The stones in the water are smoother than the ones on the hill.
items.text: These have been rolled. The sharp ones are still upslope.
items.wrenHint: Compare a rock from the slope with one from the creek. Don't take them home — just look.
items.wrenAck: Smoother in the water, sharper on the hill. That's a quiet kind of clock.

items.name: Cattail marsh
items.prompt: The ground gives a little. It smells like wet leaves.
items.text: Water isn't only in the creek. It's in the ground here, holding up the reeds.
items.wrenHint: West of the pond it gets squishy. Boots tell the truth before maps do.
items.wrenAck: The marsh keeps water around even after the creek calms down.

items.name: Weathered ledge
items.prompt: The face of this rock is crumbling.
items.text: Some pieces are already more soil than stone. The knob is shedding itself.
items.wrenHint: There's a crumbly ledge on the knob, not the smooth face. Different story.
items.wrenAck: That crumbling ledge is how mountains become soil, given enough time.

items.name: Rain rills
items.prompt: Tiny channels after the rain, shining where the grass parted.
items.text: The hill is moving, slowly, one night at a time.
items.wrenHint: On the steep west face, look at the grass itself — it has new partings.
items.wrenAck: Those little rills are how a slope starts a creek.

items.name: High-water mark
items.prompt: A line of sticks in the willows, higher than the water is now.
items.text: Last night's flood left a watermark. The reach remembers.
items.wrenHint: Downstream of the pond, look at the willows, not just the water.
items.wrenAck: You found the wrack line. That's why I asked about the reach.

items.name: Hillside seep
items.prompt: The soil is wet here, even though the rain has stopped.
items.text: Water is coming out of the hill, not just off it.
items.wrenHint: South of the knob the ground stays dark after a dry morning. Worth a look.
items.wrenAck: The seep is shy. Most people walk past and think it's just shade.

items.name: Watershed view
items.prompt: A low rail, and the whole hollow falling away.
items.text: From here the land tilts one way — creek, pond, reach. A single bowl.
items.wrenHint: There's a scrap of rail on the high ledge. Best place to see how the water decides.
items.wrenAck: That view is why the station was built on this shoulder, not down in the wet.
